#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: ORDER U/S 163 OF THE BHARTIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
WHEREAS, a substantial number of trucks and goods carriers regularly
transit through Silvassa City from nearby industrial areas;

#/texts/9.label: paragraph

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text:
THEREFORE, in view of above and in exercise of the power conferral
under Section 163 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, I, Amit
Kumar, Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Dadra & Nagar Haveli hereby order that
the following roads shall remain closed for heavy vehicles entering and passing
through Silvassa during the following time slots:

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text:
Morning: From 06:00 AM to 10:00 AM
Evening: From 04:00 PM to 10:00 PM

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text:
1) Khanvel to Silvassa Road via Rakholi, Masat, Samarvarni
2) Naroli to Silvassa Road via Kharapada, Athal
3) Dadra to Silvassa Road via Pipariya
4) Sayli to Silvassa Road via Baldevi
